_about: Price Check data (daily/price-check-plan.md). One entry per exact model we recommend. All figures are prices seen at stores other than Amazon, or list prices, each with its source and date; never an Amazon price (Associates Program Policies 2(b), 6(y)). 'good' and 'great' are our own lines; 'verdict' is buy (buy now), ok (fair price, no reason to wait) or wait (a sale is likely soon). Change 'checked' only when the entry was really re-checked.
